facts.fact: a new scene renders frames 1-250 at 24 fps to render.filepath '/tmp/'
render(animation=True) names files from render.filepath: no '#' appends a 4-digit frame number; a run of '#' is replaced by the zero-padded frame number at that place; use_file_extension adds .png
FFMPEG output defaults: container MKV, codec H264, quality MEDIUM (constant_rate_factor)
with format MPEG4 + codec H264 a 10-frame range renders to one .mp4 named with the frame range (clip0001-0010.mp4)
